name: Dengor Bloodheart
subjectPrompt: A massive fire giant forgepriest of Surtr, with charcoal skin, crimson braided beard tied with bronze bands, broad jaw and fiery dark amber eyes. He wears heavy matte black plate with an old bronze flame clasp on the chest and scalloped dark red cloth hanging below the waist. One huge greatsword rests diagonally point-down, his free hand open above a little restrained glow. Stands upright with commanding posture. Two unwinged shoulders, no horns or crown, entire armor and greatsword visible.

name: Shadow Dragon
subjectPrompt: Messanth, a young bronze dragon transformed into a shadow dragon. All four clawed legs, two widely separated broad leathery wings and one long curving tail. Distinct backward bronze-dragon fins by the cheeks and around its crown. Former amber-bronze scales are dark glossy translucent obsidian with intermittent bronze-green highlights beneath the black. Fine wisps of gray shadow curling off the wings and tail. Whole beast poised in low three-quarter crouch, readable at thumbnail scale, solemn intelligent eyes, no background.
